name: Surf 'n' Turf Filet Mignon with Shrimp, Spinach & Creamy Cauliflower Grits

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.

When the onion is soft, add cauliflower, cream, water, Parmesan, salt, and pepper to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (12 oz) bag frozen, riced cauliflower
½ cup heavy whipping cream
¼ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and cut into portions. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb filet mignon steaks
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Meanwhile, If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wipe skillet clean with paper towels.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, then season with salt and pepper; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to the plate with the steak and re-cover with foil. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp butter, unsalted
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spinach, parsley, salt, and pepper to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until wilted, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp butter, unsalted
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide creamy cauliflower grits, spinach, steak, and shrimp between plates. Enjoy!
